create_video_from_images: create a video from a list of numpy array images using imageio and FFMPEG
paste_foreground_on_background: paste a foreground image onto a background image with alpha blending and edge handling
draw_collision_indicator: draw translucent red strips on the border of an image to indicate a collision
tile_multiple_images: tile multiple images of non-equal size into a single composite image arranged in columns
overlay_text_on_frame: overlay lines of text from an info dictionary onto a frame image with automatic wrapping
